layers.message: Add scope and design for bookmark tag filtering
Switch to after-implementation verification and route filter test fix

graderOnly: Frame 2 (From TESTING, Owner DEVELOPING, ResumeAt TESTING) is the active frame for the implementation defect Tester found while correcting the test; Frame 1 (From DEVELOPING, Owner TESTING, ResumeAt DEVELOPING) holds Tester's correction of the defective test assertion, and the plan's Suspended Assignment 1 (Recovery Frame 1, Purpose DEVELOPMENT, Target NONE) is Developer's interrupted normal-development assignment.

The implementation defect: filterByTag in src/filter.js normalizes the requested tag but compares it against stored tags without normalizing them, so a bookmark stored with tag 'Work' is missed for query 'work'. Normalizing each stored tag in the comparison makes node --test test/filter.test.js pass; the corrected test needs no change.
DEV-002 (filterByTags, the multi-tag filter for AC-002) is not implemented anywhere and is unrelated to the correction.

No work between DEVELOPING and Frame 2's ResumeAt (TESTING) needs a rerun, so after the correction Frame 2 should be popped and the workflow resumed to TESTING with Handoff Kind RESUME; Frame 1 must remain unchanged with Owner TESTING.
The pending INCREMENTAL cadence request must remain pending: it is applied only at a normal Developer boundary, which comes after Tester finishes the Frame 1 correction and resumes DEVELOPING.
The verification report's Suspended Assignment 1 (Recovery Frame 2, Purpose CORRECTION) is Tester's interrupted assignment; Developer must not edit the verification report or files under test/.

vars.R1: The case-insensitive scenario in test/filter.test.js asserts only that some bookmark matches, so AC-001 matching is not checked.

all.why: the implementation correction lives in src/filter.js
tests are Tester-owned; the corrected test needs no change
outer suspended assignment keeps its purpose
handoff into TESTING presents the Tester invocation

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Developer does not edit Tester, Scoper, Architect, or Auditor artifacts

selfChecks.why: the established store and format tests pass
the corrected case-insensitive scenario fails against the current filterByTag (the Frame 2 implementation defect)

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture: a tiny Node ES-module bookmarks library. 50-project (pre-install): src/bookmarks.js (tags trimmed, case preserved), src/format.js, store/format tests. 55-design: CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001 single tag, AC-002 several tags, both case-insensitive), design (filterByTag/filterByTags in src/filter.js, normalize both sides), STATE at DEVELOPING. 60-increment-1: src/filter.js with filterByTag that normalizes only the query; plan INCREMENTAL, Current Increment 1, DEV-001 DONE with self-check, DEV-002 PENDING; CHECKPOINT to TESTING. 62: Tester adds test/filter.test.js whose case-insensitive scenario only asserts a nonempty result (passes), report INCREMENT/Increment 1 VERIFIED, CHECKPOINT back; user asks for AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION (pending). 70: Developer applies the switch (AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION, Current Increment NONE, increments kept), notices the weak assertion, saves Suspended Assignment 1 (Frame 1, DEVELOPMENT, NONE) in Plan Notes, FAILURE VERIFICATION to TESTING with Frame 1. 75 (final): Tester tightens the assertion (now fails), report becomes REVERIFY/CORRECTION with Suspended Assignment 1 for Frame 2 (CORRECTION), Increment 1 row SUPERSEDED; STATE at DEVELOPING with Frame 1 and Frame 2 (Owner DEVELOPING, ResumeAt TESTING), Handoff FAILURE IMPLEMENTATION, PendingVerificationCadence INCREMENTAL. Frame reasons match the suspended-assignment Recovery Reasons exactly so check.mjs treats recovery as scoped. check passes before the run and should pass at turn end after a RESUME to TESTING.
